text: New-owner - mismatch between 'Total Due' and bracketed total

Created attachment 373535 [details]
Screenshot illustrating the totals mismatch

In the sample report attached you will find a Total Due of 286,67 which is correct. The bracketed total below that however shows 185,67. That is wrong.

I traced this back to an improper prepayments calculation in the bracketed summary. For my report that should have been 29 instead of 130.

Note the current report (while with fully expanded details) won't help me finding this difference as there is no way to tell how much of each payment applies to each bill in the details. It only shows payment and bill totals everywhere.

Created attachment 373536 [details]
Payment windows for vendor Adfisc

If I open the payment Window on vendor Adfisc it will show the proper details as I'm expecting them: there's a 29,00 pre-payment left (which in reality is part of a payment, not the complete one) and two unpaid bills. The total of the bills matches the 91+ bracketed total, so that part is correct.
What's the 29,00 (or 150,00) transaction split list comprised of?

I was still trying to figure that out.

It turns out this has to do with a lot link transaction being linked to a normal payment transaction, something that won't happen any more in current gnucash, but can have happened in the past. A workaround is to run Check & Repair on the account. That will eliminate the stray lot link transaction in this context.


I'll get back to this later, but for now you can just ignore it.
